name: [🎉RELEASE] Project Hero
desc:
❗ The game is still in beta and may have bugs. Notify bugs in the server below!

Project Hero is a manga-inspired game known as "My Hero Academia" with a superhero society with 80% of the world possessing an uncanny ability! Become a hero or villain to explore and battle with anime themed powers!

Information and more : (Join the dis for more info on the game will be shown if you scroll down)
Level-Cap  - 270
Dash - Q / Run - WW
Grip - G / Carry - H
